traverse_datapipe_graph: traverse a PyTorch DataPipe graph and return a nested dictionary of DataPipe instances and their connections
traverse_datapipe_only_datapipe: traverse a PyTorch DataPipe graph filtering to only DataPipe and collection attributes
list_connected_datapipes: list all connected DataPipes from a given DataPipe using pickle hooks to capture references
build_datapipe_graph: build a DataPipeGraph from a PyTorch IterDataPipe or MapDataPipe by recursively traversing attributes
review_traverse_helper: review the _traverse_helper function for recursion safety and cache handling in DataPipe graph traversal
